Logistics Assistant Job at Logistics Assistant Job at YEHGS UK Limited




        
    

        
        YEHGS UK Limited is a company that deals with the sales of coffee, coffee machines and accessories. they are the major distributor of coffee in west africa. majority of the customers are eko hotels, radisson blu, transcorp hilton, mega plaza. etc.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Logistics Assistant

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Track incoming and outgoing shipments.
	Process shipping paperwork and invoices.
	Update inventory logs and databases.
	Talk to suppliers and delivery drivers.
	Fix delivery or stock errors.
	Good computer and Excel skills.
	Strong organizational and detail skills.
	Clear spoken and written communication.


Requirements


	Candidates should possess a minimum of an OND, with 2-5 years of work experience.


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: For more enquiries, contact: 08129207496

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Digital Content & Social Media Specialist",
  "description": "Permanent Capital Ventures is a venture studio launching new companies with fully developed technology and infrastructure already in place. We are a fast-growing tech startup building modern solutions to redefine how our industry operates. We move fast, value fresh ideas, and foster a collaborative environment where every team member has a direct impact on our growth.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Digital Content &amp; Social Media Specialist

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Do you know how to turn complex ideas into visually stunning graphics, scroll-stopping videos, and high-converting campaigns?
	We are redefining the future of property through technology.
	We are looking for a highly creative, digitally savvy, and multi-talented Digital Content &amp; Social Media Specialist to elevate our brand presence, engage our online community, and craft compelling narratives across all digital touchpoints.
	This role is ideal for a creative professional who can combine strategy, design, content creation, videography, social media, and digital marketing to deliver content that not only looks great but also drives meaningful engagement and business results.


Key Responsibilities
Content Creation &amp; Strategy:


	Conceptualise, create, edit, and publish compelling content across multiple digital platforms.
	Develop creative content ideas that educate, inform, entertain, and engage our target audience.
	Develop and maintain content calendars aligned with the company&#39;s marketing and business objectives.
	Create content for property showcases, brand campaigns, product features, industry insights, and corporate communications.
	Stay informed about emerging content formats, trends, and digital marketing best practices.


Social Media Management:


	Manage the company&#39;s social media platforms from strategy through execution.
	Develop and implement social media strategies to increase brand awareness, grow the audience, and drive engagement.
	Schedule and publish content consistently across relevant platforms.
	Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and community interactions.
	Track social media performance and provide regular reports and recommendations for improvement.
	Identify trends and opportunities to increase the company&#39;s visibility and reach.


Graphic Design:


	Independently create high-quality, visually appealing, and on-brand graphics for social media and digital marketing campaigns.
	Design marketing materials, presentations, pitch decks, promotional materials, and other visual assets as required.
	Maintain consistency in the company&#39;s visual identity across all digital platforms.
	Translate complex concepts and information into clear, engaging, and visually compelling designs.


Videography &amp; Video Production:


	Handle end-to-end video production, including concept development, filming, editing, and publishing.
	Produce engaging short-form and long-form video content for social media and other digital channels.
	Create videos for property showcases, technology features, educational content, interviews, campaigns, and brand storytelling.
	Edit videos to a high professional standard, incorporating appropriate graphics, transitions, captions, music, and other elements.
	Stay current with emerging video formats and trends, particularly short-form content.


Email Marketing:


	Plan, create, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns and newsletters.
	Develop engaging email copy and visual content designed to generate engagement and conversions.
	Manage email lists and audience segmentation where required.
	Monitor campaign performance and analyse key metrics to improve future campaigns.
	Support lead nurturing and client engagement through effective email communication.


Mandatory Requirements


	Minimum of 3 years of hands-on professional experience in digital marketing, content creation, social media management, or a related multidisciplinary role.
	Demonstrated professional experience in social media management.
	Strong practical experience in email marketing and campaign management.
	Proven graphic design skills with the ability to independently produce high-quality visual content.
	Proven videography and video editing skills.
	Strong ability to create engaging, original, and platform-specific content.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong creative thinking, storytelling, and conceptualisation skills.
	A strong portfolio demonstrating previous graphic design, video production, social media, and content creation work.
	Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Platforms &amp; Tools:
The successful candidate should be comfortable working with relevant digital platforms and tools, including:


	Social Media: LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and X.
	Design: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Canva, and/or Figma.
	Video: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, and/or DaVinci Resolve.
	Email Marketing: Mailchimp, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Constant Contact, or similar platforms.
	Social Media Management &amp; Analytics: Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and other relevant analytics or scheduling tools.


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 per month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume and Portfolio (including video editing and graphic design samples) to: Support@perma-capital.com using the&nbsp;&nbsp;Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	Ready to build the future of proptech marketing with us? Apply.
	Candidates are not necessarily required to have experience with every tool listed, but must demonstrate strong proficiency with relevant industry-standard platforms.

ECP Services & Contracts  Engineer Job at SPIE Oil & Gas Services




        
    

        
        SPIE Oil & Gas Services (part of the SPIE Group) provides a complete range of services to some of the world’s largest oil and gas companies through its network of offices in 25 countries across Africa, the Middle-East and Asia-Pacific.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: ECP Services & Contracts  Engineer

Job Reference: 2026-44371
Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Track WBS / PDC / NAPIMS Budget performance.
	Tracking of NAPIMS Contract CFTs.
	Compile and review all ECP COMPANY/NAPIMS yearly budget WPs (IB, RB, FYP) including backup documents and transmit to PAR.
	Also ensure smooth coordination of dry-runs as at when due.
	Ensure performance of budget lines are monitored and potential over runs flagged. Ensure VM dashboard is updated.
	Advise technical responsibility on over-performance, underperformance, performance without authorization, feedback from NAPIMS etc.
	Ensure contracts are implemented as stipulated.
	Ensure that ECP Contract register is updated, weekly.
	Maintain database of running and forecast Contracts.
	Assist to interface with PAR / NAPIMS / NCDMB / DPR and other 3rd parties on SUBCOM, Quarterly True-Ups Meetings & Sessions.
	Analyze ECP budget performance and report. Circulate Budget performance status and report.
	Prepare ECP monthly cost accuracy estimate and report.
	Follow up with technical responsible to close out identified PAR / C&P / SCC issues.
	Prepare monthly ECP PAR dashboard and KPI.
	Secretary to ECP Project Steering Committee meeting.


Qualifications / Experience Required


	Engineering background with a minimum of 13 years of experience in construction of O&G installations.
	Good English.
	Good interpersonal and communication skills.
	Use of Microsoft Project, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, AutoCAD, SAP, BW, CONTIKI, CARS.

Facilities Coordinator Job at Atis Limited




        
    

        
        At Atis Limited, our vision is to be the leading real estate consultancy in Nigeria. Delivering quality, strategic and Commercial solutions to occupiers and investors. Our values are Excellence, Integrity and Professionalism combined with energy and Innovation. We focus on development of a lasting business relationship that transcends in real estate transaction. Our priorities are the development of strategies and effective implementation of transactions to ensure that corporate objectives are met. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Facilities Coordinator

Job Location: Ikorodu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking to employ a Facilities Operations Manager who will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of a specified site, ensuring a safe, efficient, and positive environment for staff, customers, and visitors.
	The role involves managing site personnel and activities, ensuring all tasks are executed effectively, within scope, and in line with established timelines.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee and monitor the progress of all site activities.
	Review daily site operations and recommend improvement measures where necessary.
	Ensure timely completion of projects in accordance with set timelines.
	Interpret and translate technical drawings and blueprints into actionable plans.
	Coordinate and supervise site workers and contractors.
	Develop and manage work schedules for site personnel.
	Liaise with contractors, managers, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless coordination.
	Maintain and enforce safety and quality standards on site.
	Organize and allocate equipment and manpower required for project execution.
	Ensure all equipment is in good working condition and properly maintained.
	Prepare and present reports, budgets, and project plans to relevant stakeholders.
	Carry out any other duties as assigned by the Facilities Supervisor.


Requirements


	A Bachelor’s Degree in Structural Engineering, Construction Management, Estate Management, or a related field; alternatively, significant hands-on experience in any of these fields will be considered.
	Ability to interpret technical documents and blueprints.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
	Strong reporting and documentation skills.
	Experience in budget management and project scheduling.
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
